document: Abacus Data BC Poll: Eby Government Holds the Edge a Year After the Provincial Election (Abacus Data, 2025-10-20)
note: Online panel, n=1,000. Shares among committed (decided) voters, read from the chart 'Committed voters - by region & age' (slide 8, image-76 on the page). 26% undecided overall. Regional bases not published; National n = total sample. Region labels verbatim: Vancouver / Lower Mainland (coded LOWER-MAINLAND; release text calls it Metro Vancouver), Other BC Area (new code OUTSIDE-LOWER-MAINLAND: Vancouver Island + Interior + North).
